A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] recon '''officer''' was part of the personnel at [[Ghost Base]], a Rebel installation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Krant]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> between [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the mission's events during that time period.</ref> At [[Battle of Krant (Galactic Civil War)|one point]] during his time at the base, he was [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] and discovered that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Strike force Alpha]] was preparing to attack Ghost Base. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] tried to delay the strike force but was wounded in the attempt. Strike Force Alpha took control of Ghost Base and established its own military camp among the base's remains. The officer was later discovered by a Rebel team led by the [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and he recounted his story to the team.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer was mentioned in the Reconnaissance briefing before the second [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia campaign mission in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="SW:GB" />
